_note: v2.5 plan 02 / plan 05 F0 A11 forced-timeout arm (review #28). live-v24-03-memorize.json plus one step: storyOrchestratorDebugCallBudgetScale (src/extraction/callBudget.ts callTimeoutMs, inert at 1, cleared by --sandbox start and cleanup) is set from localStorage 'so-v25-a11-scale', computed by `node scripts/debug/so-timeout-arm.mts scale <base-run.log>` from a base run on the SAME lane and backend, so the whole-chat pass times out on its first ask and answers on its 2x retry while every other pass still answers on its retry. Pass: timeoutRetries holds the whole-chat pass, its first ask gave up at the scaled budget (+-5 %/5 s), the backlog completes with no lastError. Negative control, run once on a mutant build (TIMEOUT_RETRY_SCALE = 1 in callBudget.ts, or retryOnTimeout calling ask(1) only): set localStorage 'so-v25-a11-control' = '1'; the arm then passes only when the backlog FAILS with lastError naming the budget. Lanes only, other lane idle. v2.4 plan 03 live gate 3 (+ gate 6, Stop half). Real model, so-scenario --sandbox --group 1759606632088, lanes only; run it with the other lane idle, because its requests are near the context limit and share the backend. The sandbox chat is seeded in-page with 330 synthetic log rows (seeded PRNG over a fixed vocabulary, about 1300 characters each: nobody's real chat), alternating the persona and two group members, saved and reloaded; the seeded rows commit no boundary. At that size the chat is larger than the extraction profile's input budget (preset max_length 98304 -> inputBudget 87961 on this install), so the whole-chat pass must be tail-fit. Cadence is 99 so no cadence read competes. PART 1 (Stop): Memorize chat (manager.memorizeChat, the drawer's path) asks the preflight confirm (answered Send); once one window is applied and another read is in flight, assert-player-clean runs in player mode with Stop visible, Stop is hit-tested and pressed while a read is in flight: running goes false, stoppedNote is set and lastError is not, applied windows and memory rows are kept, the in-flight request rejects as AbortError, and Memorize chat is enabled again. PART 2 (full run): once the scheduler is idle, runMemorizeBacklog() (the debug handle: no preflight) must complete; every memorize:window and memorize:full audit carries a budget record whose estimate is <= inputBudget, the windows cover the chat in order with no gap, the full pass carries trimmedFrom and ends at the newest message, and every captured request's true size (llama's tokens_evaluated) fits the context (contextLimit - maxTokens); the estimate error (true - inputBudget) is recorded, since the 10 % margin exists because the count is an estimate. A11 (post-freeze): a read that timed out and is followed by the same prompt is the product's one retry at 2x budget (retryOnTimeout); it is reported as timeoutRetries and is not counted as a failed request or an extra pass. A timeout with no same-prompt follow-up, or a retry that also fails, still fails. The backlog wait is 40 min so a 2x retry of the whole-chat pass fits. v2.5 plan 02 (A11 forced-timeout arm, review #28): when the arm marker R.forcedArm is set (only by live-v25-05-memorize-timeout.json), the last step also requires a timeout retry whose retry is the whole-chat pass, with the first ask giving up at the scaled budget; with R.forcedArm.control it instead requires the backlog to fail with lastError naming the budget. Without the marker this step is unchanged.
